translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Mu zikhumbu ziwombo ayi mu zinzila ziwombo, Nzambi wuyolukila mutsi khulu, bakulu beto mu nzila yi mimbikudi.
Vayi mu bilumbu biabi bi tsuka Nzambi wutuyolukila mu Muanꞌandi, mutu wowo kabieka mvingidi wu bima bioso ayi mu niandi kavangila bima bioso.

Muana beni wulembo monikisa lezama ku nkembo wu Nzambi ayi niandi mfikula yimonisa bumboti bumutu buandi. Niandi weta kindisa bima bioso mu mambu mandi ma lulendo. Bu kamanisa kubika tsukudulu yi masumu ; buna wuvuanda ku Diyilu va koko ku lubakala lu Nzambi, nkua ngolo yoso.
Buna niandi wulutila zimbasi mu luvalu bila dizina di katambula dilutidi dizina di zimbasi.
Muaki kuidi mbasi mbi yoyi Nzambi kakamba :

content.text: minu ndibutidi mu lumbu kiaki Voti diaka :
ayi niandi wela ba muanꞌama e ?

content: Bosi bu kakotisa mutu wutheti wu butuka va nza, wubuela tuba ti :
Mu diambu di zimbasi, niandi wutuba ti :

content.text: ayi bisadi biandi minlaki mi mbazu.

content: Vayi mu diambu di Muana, niandi wutuba ti :

content.text: A Nzambi, kundu kiaku ki kipfumu kinzinganga
Nkawꞌaku wu busonga widi nkawa wu kipfumu
ngeyo wuvanga zifundasio zi ntoto ayi
vayi ngeyo wela zinga mu mimvu mi kamimani ;
Wela bizinga banga bu nzingulungu nledi

content: Ayi kuidi mbasi mbi katuba ti :

content.text: nate ndiela mana kitula bambeni ziaku

content: A ziawu zisi ko ziphevi zinsadilanga Nzambi, zifidusu mu diambu di sadila batu bobo bela vinginina kiuka ki phulusu e ?

footnotes.text: 1.8 Nkawa wu kipfumu: voti wela yadila kipfumu kiaku mu busonga.
